inputs.title: Choose the video and subtitle
inputs.description: Sync works on one pair at a time. Drop the files anywhere on this window or browse for them.
inputs.dropzone: Drop a video and a subtitle here

media.label: Video or audio
media.hint: The soundtrack the subtitle is measured against.

subtitle.label: Subtitle
subtitle.hint: The file whose timing will be shifted.

inputs.subtitleOnly: Without a video or audio file there is nothing to analyse, so this run is limited to entering an offset yourself.

method.title: How should the offset be found?
method.description: Detection runs entirely on this computer. No account, no network request, no cost.

auto.name: Detect it automatically
auto.hint: Listens for speech in the media file and compares it with the subtitle timing.
auto.needsMedia: Add a video or audio file to enable detection.

manual.name: Enter it myself
manual.hint: Shift every cue by an amount you already know.

sensitivity.label: Speech sensitivity
sensitivity.hint: Lower is stricter: quieter passages are less likely to count as speech.
sensitivity.perRun: This applies to this run only and does not change your saved settings.

detect.title: Review the offset
detect.description: The value below is what will be applied. Adjust it if the result is close but not exact.

offset.label: Offset in milliseconds
offset.hint: A positive value delays the subtitles; a negative one makes them appear sooner.
offset.exceedsMax: This is beyond the {{limit}} second limit in your settings. Reduce it to continue.

apply.title: Save the synced subtitle
apply.summary: Every cue will move by {{seconds}} seconds.
apply.originalKept: The file you selected is never changed; the shifted copy is written to the path above.
